strongest_angle: Actor James McAvoy transitions to the director's chair with his feature debut California Schemin, exploring a true story of Scottish rappers who faked American identities.

key_facts.fact: Actor James McAvoy makes his feature directorial debut with the film California Schemin, released in theaters on October 9, 2026.
The film California Schemin has a runtime of 107 minutes and is rated R according to Roger Ebert reviews published in October 2026.
Magenta Light Studios set the fall release date for James McAvoy's directorial debut California Schemin in April 2026.
Director James McAvoy stated in an interview with Moviefone that he has been thinking about directing since he was 16 years old.

numbers.label: Age James McAvoy started thinking about directing

quotes.text: I've been thinking about directing since I was 16. I should have done it sooner
